what_this_is: Systems that consume this store's corpus and cite it by verify URL. Empty until one does. An entry is added only with a dated citation URL, and scripts/citations-check.mjs fetches that URL and fails when the citation is gone. The page at /scorers renders this file; nothing is typed there.
how_a_system_gets_listed: Its public page cites a row of this corpus by verify URL (https://scvd.store/api/verify/{id}) or by corpus URL (https://scvd.store/corpus/...). Name, the citing URL, and the date it was first seen; nothing else, and no endorsement in either direction.
